problems.detail: Receipt summary states '2 BOUND real + 7 UNBOUND planned argv' but the registry actually holds 8 UNBOUND entries (fork.install_deps, fork.build_worker, fork.worker_launch_rpc, fork.worker_stop, cli.entry_run, desktop.shell_launch, desktop.installer_build, protocol.v2_roundtrip). Understatement, not inflation; all 8 are genuine UNBOUND and the REGISTRY_INVARIANTS test threshold (>=7) is met by the true count of 8. No behavioral impact.

execution/v2.4/step_state.json is modified by this commit although it is not one of the 5 enumerated allowed-scope paths. The change is append-only (adds only the W02-02 EXECUTION_REPORTED entry, no other step altered) and does not self-accept, so it is consistent with the harness contract and with the card's own expectation that step_state stays EXECUTION_REPORTED until independent review; recorded here as a scope-adjacency observation.

limitations.detail: The BOUND validator hard-codes an absolute, machine-specific path to the external delivery package (D:/作品集/.../ResearchOS_Implementation_Package_v2.4/tools/validate_package.py), outside the repository and outside the pinned .local/worktrees/v24-continuation/spec/v2.4 snapshot that current_spec.json references. It validates the current v2.4 spec today (real PASS/12), but it is non-portable and is not self-contained in the delivered snapshot. Once 18 §2 item 1 copies the read-only v2.4 snapshot into the repo (spec/v2.4), this argv should be re-pointed to the in-repo validator copy so the check is reproducible independent of the working machine.

The auto route only checks that execution/v2.4/current_spec.json exists (Path.is_file) plus that the key is present in the v2.4 registry, whereas commands.json's selection_rule wording says auto prefers v2.4 'only when current_spec.json is valid'. Existence is weaker than content-validity. Functionally correct given the current pointer is present and correct (AUTO_POINTER_V24 passed and explicit --spec routes deterministically); low severity, worth tightening when the snapshot lands in-repo.

scope_note: Independent review of the W02-02 increment only. It does not accept the parent task W02, does not run formal cases A03/A15 final verification, and does not change step_state; acceptance of W02-02 remains a separate registration by the orchestrator.
summary: ACCEPT. All eight mandatory checks pass on first-hand execution: the self-running dispatcher test is real (30 assertions with the 9 v2.4 checks genuinely calling dispatch.execute and asserting status/exit_code/registry_spec), all five CLI routes and their registry_spec fields reproduce exactly, the wildcard fix and its disclosure are truthful (reproduced the pre-fix failure and confirmed legacy strictness is unaffected), commands.json meets the BOUND/UNBOUND and no-echo-PASS bar, client_mapping.json matches the SPEC schema 23/14 with full owner-card coverage and no readiness overclaim, the legacy test body and old registry are preserved, there is no A03/A15/self-acceptance overclaim, and the repo has 0 tracked modifications and no gitlink. Remaining items are two minor inaccuracies (P1 undercount of UNBOUND, P2 step_state scope-adjacency) and two carried limitations (L1 non-portable external validator binding, L2 auto-route existence-vs-validity), none of which block acceptance; they should be remediated when the v2.4 snapshot is vendored in-repo.
